battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: I wanted to be on [WOODROW]'s team...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ウッドロウ様の方のチームに行きたいです。
ああああああああああああああああああああああああ

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Sword of eternal flame... Unleash your power![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 真の姿を現せ、ゴーエンの剣!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Scorch my enemies down to their very souls![END]
[COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: I'm not going down without a fight![END]
[COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: With this sword, I'll carve a path to the future![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: こいつは、未来へ託す永劫の剣だ!
全て塵になってしまえ!
チャンスと片付けるわよ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: This is going to be fun![END]
[COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Guide us to the healing embrace....[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 全てを癒す導きを示さん。
ライフディスチャージ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Instantly sink into its cold embrace![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 霊気に抱かれて刹那に沈め!
全ての流れを無に返さん!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][ATWIGHT][COLOR_END]: I shall lend you my power.[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: みなさん、頑張りましょう!
挟まれてしまいました!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Divine judgement for an evil soul![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 悪しき魂に神の裁きを!
セイクリットブレイム!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Here I go, with all I've got![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: とどめ、ディバインパワー!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Come forth, O bolt of life![END]
[COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Roar in fury, O earth of creation![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: リバースクルセイダー!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Time to be rid of this filth![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: ジョウハメショウエン!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Be consumed by the flames of darkness![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 闇の炎に抱かれて消えろ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: I'll cut myself free from my past![END]
[COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: I'll end this in one strike![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 一気に蹴りをつけるぞ!
強撃だ!体勢を立て直せ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: We must be on our guard![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 気を引き締めればならんな!
レッショウソウハジン!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: Eternal gale, lend me your power![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 永劫なる風よ、我が一心に集え!
リミッターを外させてもらう。
ここで屈するわけにはいかん!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: They don't look like much trouble.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: 그리 대단한 적은 아닌 것 같네.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 大した敵じゃなさそうだね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: Well, let's get a move on.[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 本気で生かしてもらうよ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: Let me show you what I got![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 本気で生かしてもらうよ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Who wants a piece of this?[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: 한 대 맞고 싶은 놈은 누구냐![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 乗されたいのはドイツだ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: I'll take you on from any direction![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: どっからでもかかってこんかい!
チャンピオンをなめるなよ!
チャンピオンをなめるなよ!
うおおおおおおおおおおお!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Come on! I'm coming for you![END]
[COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Behold the glory of my voice![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 援護を任せてください!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: We won't lose to the likes of you![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 対戦自虐で負けません!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: Unbound wings, soar to the heavens![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: 그 누구에게도 얽매이지 않는 날개여, 지금 날아올라라![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 何者にも縛られぬ翼、今、飛び立て!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: They seem to be behind us.[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 強そうに見えるけど気のせい?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: Now witness my super secret technique![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: とか言ってみたりして。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: What am I to do with you!?[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 負けるわけにはいかないぜ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: That was a piece of cake.[END]
[COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: That got me really fired up![END]
[COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Geez, what a waste of my time![END]
[COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: This pushover wasn't even worth the lens.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 너무 약하잖아! 렌즈라도 챙겨서 다시 와![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 弱すぎよ!レンズ抱えて手直してらっしゃい!
ダラダラやってんじゃないわよ!
まったく割に合わないよね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: The more you borrow, the more you pay back![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 빚도 복수도 두 배로 갚는 게...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 借金も仕返しも倍返しが原則よ!
借金も仕返しも倍返しが原則よ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: I'm doing the best I can![END]
[COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: This, too, is part of my training.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: これも修行の一環ですね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Oh Atamoni, were you testing us?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: これも神の試練ですね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Reflect on your sins, and find salvation![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 反省すればきっと救われますよ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: The outcome will always be the same, no matter what![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: 결과는 변하지 않아. 몇 번을 해도 마찬가지다.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 結果は変わらん。そう、何度やってもだ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: They were foolish to face me.[END]
[COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: I doubt we'll run into the likes of you ever again.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: もう二度と会うこともないだろう。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: We'll never see your face again![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: もう二度と会うこともないだろう。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Small fry should stick to the pond.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ザコはザコらしくしていろ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: I wasn't prepared for that... I'm getting sloppy.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 油断しすぎたようだな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Did you really think you'd win!?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 勝てるとでも思ったのか?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: I'll show no mercy to those who stand in my way![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 行く手を塞ぐのならば、容赦はせん。
行く手を塞ぐのならば、容赦はせん。
よし、この調子で行くぞ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: Be more careful of who you attack next time.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 次は相手を選ぶことだな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: That battle felt more like a war...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 道のりは険しいようだな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: What a fierce opponent... We need to be more careful.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 強敵だった。これからも油断できんな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: There's a reason why I won't lose![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 負けられない理由があるのだよ。
負けられない理由があるのだよ。
未熟なくせに強がるからさ!
未熟なくせに強がるからさ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: That dragged on way too long...[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 危ないところだったね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: Excessive? No. I put it out of its misery.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: 단숨에 끝내 주는 게 자비라는 거야![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 一気に決めるのが慈悲ってもんさ!
俺様がチャンピオンよ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Now! Swear on my bicep that you'll never do evil again![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: 다신 못된 짓 안 한다고 이 이두근에 맹세해라![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: もう悪さしないと、この上腕二頭筋に近い!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: A Round One K.O.! That's how it's done![END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: 泥試合を見せちまったな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Whew, they even did a number on me. Not bad![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: この筋肉に傷をつけると、やるじゃねえか!
これぞマッスルカーニバル!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Have you fallen for me yet?[END]
[COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Were they supposed to be tough?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ノリが悪いぜ、あんたら。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Perhaps it was too much for you...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ノリが悪いぜ、あんたら。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Is it time to return already?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: おかえりはあちらだぜ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: I'm sorry, I don't do encores.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: アンコールは受け付けないぜ

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Maybe things got a little too heated...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: チート、熱くなりすぎたか。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Were you not pleased? Will we meet again?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: しびれたろ?また来るかい?
敵さんなんて一網打尽です!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: Such dummies, thinking that they could beat us.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 私たちに勝とうなんて、今後どうだん雨あられだね。
手こずっちゃいましたね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: What a mess to clean up.[END]
[COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: They needed some more time in the oven.[END]
[COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: That was not an easy fight.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 戦いも楽じゃないわね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: Huh, maybe they had some skill...[END]

battle_subtitles.japanese: いい加減にしなさいね。
いい加減にしなさいね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Hold on, now's not the time to sleep![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ちょっと、いつまで寝てんの?
もういい、置いていくぞ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: You couldn't even lay a finger on me![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: 너희는 내게 손끝 하나 댈 수 없다.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 貴様らには指一本触れることはできん。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Well, that's not fair. Some of them don't even have fingers![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: まあ無理だと思うぜ。形が形だしな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: I'm a pretty strong fighter now.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 俺も結構強くなったよな。
お前などまだまだヒヨッコだ。
あれ?いつの間に終わってんの?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][ATWIGHT][COLOR_END]: You're the one who dealt the final blow...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: とどめさしたのはあなただけど。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: So this is the swordian's power...[END]
[COLOR_START][CLEMENTE][COLOR_END]: A swordian's strength is reliant on their master's.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][CLEMENTE][COLOR_END]: 소디언의 힘도 마스터가 있어야 발휘되는 게지.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ソーディアンの力は、マスターでこそじゃ。

battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: 이 검은 피할 수 없는 모양이군.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: この剣、かわせぬようだな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: Your swift strikes always hit their mark.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 貴様らごときでは見切れまい。
ザコめ、本気を出すまでもない。
さすが坊ちゃんですね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: We won! Did you see that Lord - Hey! You're not [WOODROW]![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: やりましたウッドロウさん!っていなーい!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: I've been here the whole time![END]
[COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: They were so tough I had to unleash my inner beast.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 手強かったな。分身の術を使うとは。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: I'm pretty sure that's how you always fight...[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 그냥 똑같은 녀석이 여럿 있었을 뿐이잖아.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 同じのがいっぱいいただけだって。
聞いてくれたかい?俺の歌を。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: I wouldn't call that a song...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: つーか、歌じゃねえだろ今の。
お兄ちゃんだらしないわね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: How're you able to fight so well in that getup?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: しかしその服装でよく戦えるね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Ya need to eat more meat! Yer underweight![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: 너무 말랐어. 고기 좀 더 먹어라.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 痩せすぎだぜ。もっと肉食いな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: That was tough... Don't think we'd survive a second round.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 手強かった。次も勝てるとは限らないな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: I never want to encounter him again.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 난 두 번 다시 만나고 싶지 않아.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 私は二度と会いたくないわね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Weapons are evil! We don't need weapons! Gyahahaha![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: 무기를 쓰다니 사도다! 무기 따윈 필요 없어![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 武器を使うなど邪道!武器など用はない!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: He's not referring to me, is he...?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: その言葉、我に対する挑戦か。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: [CHELSEA], what did that tree say just now?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: チェルシー、あの木は何か言ってたか?

battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: 네? 아니, 그게, 별말 안 했어요.[END]

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MARY][COLOR_END]: Do bats have a strong or weak voice?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: コウモリは音波に強いのか?弱いのか?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: Why would you ask me such a question...?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: なんで俺にそれを聞くんだ?
飛ぶ鳥を落とす勢いです!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: ...Are you talking about us or them?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: どちらの意味で言ってます?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: How do I say this? GET OUTTA THE WAY![END]
[COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: My body is flawless! The cold means nothing![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: 단련한 이 몸에 추위 따윈 아무것도 아니지![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 鍛え抜かれたこの肉体、寒さなんぞは目じゃねえぜ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Doesn't looking at him make you feel colder?[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 보는 사람은 춥다는 생각 안 해?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 見てる方が寒いとか考えないわけ?
ルーティさんがそんなこと言います?
そういうジョーちゃんもな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Are you seriously searching for gald DURING BATTLE?![END]
[COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: If I don't, how can I ever reach one million?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 1億ガルドくれるなら、やめてもいいけど?
ウッドロウ様、私は、私は。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: I am VICTORIOUS... but why do I feel empty?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 勝ったぜ!しかし、このやるせなさはなんなんで!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Now that is how we do it![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: これが俺たちの実力だ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Well, that is how YOU do it.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ああ、それがお前の実力だ。
確かに、それがあんたの実力ね。
え?スタンさん、ごめんなさい。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Hey... How long're you gonna follow me around, anyway?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: なあ、いつまでついてくる気だ?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LILITH][COLOR_END]: How long until you come back home!?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: いつになったら帰ってくるの?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Hmm, perhaps we don't need the guys?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ま、男どもが頼りないっていうか。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][KONGMAN][COLOR_END]: Nothing can withstand the might of our muscles![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: この筋肉にかなうものなし!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: This party might be a little too macho for me...[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: 이런 남자 냄새 나는 일행은 사양하겠어.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 俺はこんな男臭いパーティーは遠慮したいね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: It's pretty quiet when [STAHN]'s not around.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: スタンがいないと騒がしくなくていいわね。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHELSEA][COLOR_END]: Without Lord [WOODROW], I don't think I can win...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ウッドロウ様がいないと倒しがいがないです。
フィリアさんがいないと筋肉も悲しむぜ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: Wait, what are you two going on about?[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 얘기가 이상한 쪽으로 흐르는 거 아냐?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 話が間違った方向に行ってない?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: I feel like I've been going around in circles.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: 같은 곳을 빙빙 도는 기분이 들어서요.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 同じところをぐるぐる回っている気がして。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][WOODROW][COLOR_END]: I have also felt like that before...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 私もそう思っていたところだ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: I wonder what causes that feeling...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 何か思い当たることはないかな?
アワーグラス、効果は絶大だな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: I could sleep as much as I want with this.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: 이걸 쓰면 오래 잘 수 있겠네.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: これを使えば長い間寝ていられるな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][JOHNNY][COLOR_END]: That would be the worst use of it ever.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: この世で一番もったいない使い方だな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Get out of my way if you want to live![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 死にたくなければそこをどけ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: I'll cut down anyone in my way.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 邪魔する者は全て斬る。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHALTIER][COLOR_END]: Would be nice if all of them were like that.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 常にこうありたいものですね。
さすがですね、ぼっちゃん!
全力を出すまでもない。

battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START]바르바토스[COLOR_END]: 말도 안 돼! 있을 수 없어! 있을 수 없다고![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: バカな!ありえん!ありえんぞ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START]Soldier[COLOR_END]: They must be captured at all costs![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 何としても捉えるんだ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: What the hell is going on!?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 何がどうなってるんだ!?

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: No time for questions! We gotta defend ourselves![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: 시끄러워! 날아드는 불똥은 털어 내면 그만이야![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ごちゃごちゃ言わない!降りかかる火の粉は払うまでよ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Damn! We can't deal with much more of this![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: クソ!これじゃ拉致が開かない!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][RUTEE][COLOR_END]: I'mma wipe that smug look off your face![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 生意気そうな顔して腹立つわね。喧嘩を売ったこと、後悔させてやるわ。

battle_subtitles.string: You'll regret pick a fight with us![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: 싸움을 건 걸 후회하게 해 주겠어![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 生意気そうな顔して腹立つわね。喧嘩を売ったこと、後悔させてやるわ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: Now, let me show you the true power of the Swordians.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: 자, 너희 소디언의 힘을 보여 봐라.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: さあ、見せてもらうぞ、お前たちのソーディアンの力!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][PHILIA][COLOR_END]: Those monsters...! They're the ones that petrified me![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: あのモンスター、私を石に変えたのもあいつですわ!
あのモンスター、私を石に変えたのもあいつですわ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: No matter the odds, we won't lose![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 何が相手だろうと負けるか!
身の程知らずの崖どもが!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][BATISTA][COLOR_END]: Such weaklings. Ending you was a mercy![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][BATISTA][COLOR_END]: 너무 약해서 힘 조절을 못 했군![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 弱すぎて手加減し損なっちまったぜ!
こいつが例の凶悪なモンスターか。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: We've come too far to give up! Let's do this![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: 여기까지 와서 질 수는 없어! 다들 조금만 더 힘내![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ここまで来て負けられるか!みんな!もうひと踏ん張りだ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: What IS this thing?! An octopus!?[END]
[COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: A Kraken! This monster is feared as a devil of the sea![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: 얕보지 마라! 바다의 악마로 두려움을 사는 괴물이다![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 侮ってはいかん!相手は海の悪魔と恐れられる怪物だぞ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][TIBERIUS][COLOR_END]: I am the king of Aquaveil![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 世はアクアベイルの大王なり。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][TIBERIUS][COLOR_END]: Kneel, or I'll cut you down![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 世の威光に跪くがいい。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][DALIS][COLOR_END]: Now that you've come this far, there will be no mercy![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ここまで来たからには容赦はしない!
フフフフフフ、絶望に打ち震え、最悪の死を迎えるがいい。

battle_subtitles.string: as I deliver onto you a horrific death![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: フフフフフフ、絶望に打ち震え、最悪の死を迎えるがいい。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: Stop, Leon! Why are you doing this!?[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][STAHN][COLOR_END]: 그만둬, 리온! 왜 우리가 싸워야 해!?[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: やめろリオン!どうして俺たちが!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][LEON][COLOR_END]: You shall not go any further![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ここから先へは行かせない!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][BARUK][COLOR_END]: From now on, you'll learn the true meaning of war![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ここから先は戦いあるのみだ。これは戦争なのだからな!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][BARUK][COLOR_END]: In the end I remain victorious![END]
[COLOR_START][BARUK][COLOR_END]: You shall pay for your hubris![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][BARUK][COLOR_END]: 그 정도로는 나를 이길 수 없다![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: そんなことでは、私には勝てぬぞ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][BARUK][COLOR_END]: So this is your true strength...[END]
[COLOR_START][ILENE][COLOR_END]: I will not allow YOU to stop me![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: あなたたちに私は止められない!

battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][REMBRANDT][COLOR_END]: 천상군의 기술을 집약한 특수 장비의 위력![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 天上軍の技術の推移を極めた特殊装備の威力、

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][REMBRANDT][COLOR_END]: Prepare to face it's terrible power![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: ご覧いただきましょう。
終わりだ。すぐ楽にしてやろう。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: You've done well...to have bested me...[END]
[COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: I had hoped for a different outcome...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: こんな結果になろうとは。
こいつは炎に耐性を持っている。
水の小術は効かないようね。
小術に強いようですよ。
剣があまり効かないようですよ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHALTIER][COLOR_END]: They seem weak to your blade![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 小術に弱いようですよ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][CHALTIER][COLOR_END]: They seem weak to your magic![END]
[COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: Wind skills don't work on these guys.[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: 저 녀석에겐 바람 계열 정술이 잘 통하지 않는군.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 奴には風系の小術は聞きづらいようだ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: They're vulnerable to your bow attacks![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 奴は弓矢の攻撃に弱いぞ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: They're vulnerable to your sword attacks![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 奴は剣の攻撃に弱いぞ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: They seem to be weak to wind artes![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][IGTENOS][COLOR_END]: 저 녀석은 바람 계열 정술에 약한 모양이군.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: やつは風系の小術に弱いようだな。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: You insects are no match for a god![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: 지극히 높은 천상왕인 나를 너희 따위가 당해 낼 성싶으냐![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 至高の天上をたる私にお前たちごときがかなうものか。
身の程をわきまえよう!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: As expected, you were not worthy.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: やはり本気を出すまでもなかったか。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: He's no god, just a thousand-year-old[END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: 저기 있는 건 신 따위가 아니다.[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: あそこにいるのは神などではない。盲衆に取り憑かれた千年前の亡霊だ。

battle_subtitles.translation: 망집에 사로잡힌 천 년 전의 망령이다![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: あそこにいるのは神などではない。盲衆に取り憑かれた千年前の亡霊だ。

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: Thus, by our hand, we shall end this![END]
battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][DYMLOS][COLOR_END]: 그러니 우리 손으로 그 속박을 풀어 주겠다![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 故にその字幕を我らの手で解き放つ!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: Fade into the chasm between light and dark![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 光と闇の狭間に消えろ!
死ね死ね死ね死ね死ね死んだー!
死ね死ね死ね死ね死ね死んだー!

battle_subtitles.string: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: Into the void of your own despair...[END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: 絶望の口に果てよ! 虚空の青!
そろそろお前らに負けてきた!

battle_subtitles.translation: [COLOR_START][MIKTRAN][COLOR_END]: 똑똑히 보아라, 모든 것을 지워 주마![END]
battle_subtitles.japanese: しかとみよ、すべてを消し去ってくれるわ!
